2023-3755-4518-5223.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1170-5465-8164.description:
Cast a copy of Soul Tether by paying {R/G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Heartwood Crafter. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Resolve Soul Tether, creating a Heartwood token.
Activate the Heartwood by tapping it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat.

4875-4881-6909-6974.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{R} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
4875-4881-6909-6974.description:
Cast Ashling's Command by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 3, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 5.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

3197-5662-5686--196.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying its mana cost.
When Herd Baloth enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Reyhan triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 5.

3457-5821-7791.description:
Activate Fyndhorn Elder by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Fyndhorn Elder.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Fyndhorn Elder.
Repeat.

643-5256-5659-6482.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Avenging Angel.
When Avenging Angel dies, it triggers, putting itself from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill cards equal to Avenging Angel's power, which will cause you to mill Avenging Angel.
As Avenging Angel is a Lhurgoyf due to Maskwood Nexus, Disa's first ability triggers, returning Avenging Angel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3258-5775-7417.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fortune.
3258-5775-7417.description:
If Beacon of Tomorrows is in your library, cast a copy of Wild Idea by paying {3}{U}{R}, searching your library for Beacon of Tomorrows and putting it into your hand.
If Sanar doesn't have summoning sickness, activate it by tapping it, creating a Treasure token. Then, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Beacon of Tomorrows by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Beacon of Tomorrows into your library.
Blink Sanar using Fortune. It'll enter prepared due to its static effect.
Repeat each turn.
3258-5775-7417.notes: If Beacon of Tomorrows is in your hand to start, you can skip step 1 the first iteration and save {3}{U}{R} during that iteration. If Sanar starts with summoning sickness, you need an additional {U} the first iteration.

2308-4050-4871-6752.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain any amount of life.
2308-4050-4871-6752.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Trudge Garden triggers. Choose not to pay.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {1}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Haliya triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Haliya trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

527-1409-3480.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {3}{G}{U}.
Activate Selvala by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Selvala enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Selvala.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with three or more charge counters on it

236-1978-2593.description:
Animate Astral Cornucopia using Bring to Life.
Activate Astral Cornucopia by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Astral Cornucopia.
Repeat from step 2.

856-3263-3698-6748-6757.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar by paying {B}.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it, Grinding Station and Weapons Manufacturing trigger.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token.
When the Munitions token enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing the Munitions, as it is a Food due to Ragost.
The Munitions triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3817-3967-4681.description:
Cast Karmic Guide by paying {3}{W}{W}.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, targeting Sister Hospitaller.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Karmic Guide ability, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Sister Hospitaller ability, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2653-5702-5954-6753.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
2653-5702-5954-6753.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
2653-5702-5954-6753.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Nissa each trigger twice.
Resolve both Nissa triggers, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-2043-5231-6671.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating three token copies of Magic Pot that are 1/1 Soldiers.
Activate Thermopod three times by sacrificing the Magic Pot tokens, adding {R}{R}{R}.
When the Magic Pot tokens die, they trigger, creating three Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

1479-1671-6529.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-1671-6529.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it, Curse of the Restless Dead, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Curse of the Restless Dead trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it and Curse of the Restless Dead trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

225-2972-6455-6517.description:
Cast Encroaching Dragonstorm by paying {3}{G}.
When Encroaching Dragonstorm enters, it first ability triggers, causing you to search your library for two basic land cards and put them onto the battlefield tapped
When the lands enter the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant and Dragonback Assault trigger twice.
In response, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land.
Activate that land by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve a Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Repeat steps 4 through 6 one additional time.
Resolve a Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a 4/4 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Ganax and Encroaching Dragonstorm's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Ganax trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Encroaching Dragonstorm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the remaining Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a 4/4 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Ganax triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat

1636-4170-4871-5231.notablePrerequisites:
Fain does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional artifact.
1636-4170-4871-5231.description:
Activate Fain's third ability by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact, creating a 2/1 Inkling creature token.
When the Inkling enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Inkling, adding {R}.
When the Inkling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

3293-5231-5282.notablePrerequisites: You have a Plains exiled by Wormfang Newt.
3293-5231-5282.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Wormfang Newt, adding {R}.
When Wormfang Newt dies, its second ability triggers, returning a Plains from exile to the battlefield.
When the Plains enters the battlefield, Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Resolve the Emeria Shepherd trigger, returning Wormfang Newt from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Newt enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling a Plains.
Repeat.

2933-4013-4094.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
2933-4013-4094.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate three Eldrazi Scions by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

1742-2267-4798-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1742-2267-4798-5686.description:
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding Ovalchase Daredevil, adding {B}.
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing another creature, creating a Blood token.
When the Blood enters the battlefield, Ovalchase Daredevil triggers, returning Ovalchase Daredevil from your graveyard to your hand.
Tormod triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat.

3490-4050-5650.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures.
3490-4050-5650.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {1}.
When the creature leaves the battlefield, Boomer Scrapper's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

3532-4762-5078.notablePrerequisites: Devoted Druid does not have summoning sickness.
3532-4762-5078.description:
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {G} and removing a -1/-1 counter from Devoted Druid.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

38-392-3705-4833.description:
Cast Squee, the Immortal by paying {R}{R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
Repeat.

2627-4067.description:
Activate Azami by tapping it, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Azami.
Repeat.

3350-3591-4695.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Axis of Mortality triggers.
Activate Necropotence by paying 1 life, exiling the top card of your library face down.
Repeat step 2 until you have zero life.
Resolve the Axis of Mortality trigger, swapping your life total with an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero life.
You may repeat this on each of your turns.
